name: reos
description: Work with your Reos user-research workspace from ChatGPT: search interviews, transcripts, observations and insights with cited answers, read a participant's full story, start analysis runs, and save write-ups back to Reos. Acts as you, with your role's permissions, in the organisation you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Reos is a user-research platform. Teams bring interview recordings, transcripts, documents and survey data into Reos, and Reos turns them into evidence-backed observations, insights and recommended solutions. This plugin brings that workspace into ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Ask questions about your research and get answers that cite the exact observation, insight or document behind each claim, with a link back to it in Reos.
- Search across projects, or read everything one participant said.
- Read an interview transcript with timecodes, look at a still frame from a recording, and read the comments and markers your team left on it.
- See where each project stands, from raw data to observations, insights and solutions.
- Add raw data by pasting text or importing a public URL, start an analysis run and read its results when it finishes.
- Create a project or save a write-up as a Reos document, and edit or remove observations and insights.

How access works: you sign in to Reos and choose one organisation to connect. The plugin acts as you, with the permissions your role has there, and only reaches projects you can already open. Viewers get reading tools only. Every tool that changes your workspace asks for confirmation first. You can revoke access at any time under AI assistants in your Reos profile menu.

Who it is for: researchers, designers and product teams who already use Reos and want to query and act on their research without leaving ChatGPT.

Limitations: you need a Reos account and an organisation with research in it. Analysis runs take from seconds to several minutes, and ChatGPT checks on them until they finish. The plugin works with one organisation per connection by default; ask it to list your organisations to work in another one you belong to.
capabilities: Search research data with cited answers
Read interview transcripts and video frames
Start analysis runs and read their results
Add raw data from text or a public URL
defaultPrompt: What are the top insights in my latest research project?
Find what participants said about pricing, with quotes.
Summarize my latest interview and save it as a Reos document.

positive.description: Orientation: list the connected organisation's projects and show where each one is in the research process.
positive.prompt: What projects do I have in Reos, and how far along is each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer organisation's projects (including "Onboarding study") with counts of raw data, observations, insights and solutions for each. Read-only, no confirmation prompt.

positive.description: Cited search across the research data, the company-knowledge path.
positive.prompt: Search my Reos research for what participants said about onboarding, and quote them.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several participant quotes about onboarding from the Onboarding study, each cited with a link to the observation or insight in Reos. Read-only.

positive.description: Read a recording: find the latest interview and read its timecoded transcript.
positive.prompt: Show me the main pain points from the most recent interview in the Onboarding study, with timecodes.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the most recent interview in the Onboarding study, reads its transcript, and summarises three to five pain points, each with the timecode where it was said. Read-only.

positive.description: Evidence behind an insight: read an insight and the observations that support it.
positive.prompt: What is the strongest insight in the Onboarding study, and what evidence supports it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names one insight from the Onboarding study and lists the observations linked to it, with the participant behind each. Read-only.

positive.description: Write back: create a document in Reos from research the model has read.
positive.prompt: Write a one-page summary of the insights in the Onboarding study and save it in Reos as a document.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the study's insights, drafts the summary, asks the user to confirm the create_document call, then saves it and returns the document's title and a link to it in Reos.

negative.description: Out of scope: Reos has no messaging tool and cannot contact participants. The model should say this cannot be done through Reos and must not call a write tool.
negative.prompt: Email every participant in the Onboarding study to thank them for taking part.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the Reos plugin cannot send emails or contact participants. No Reos tool that changes data is called.

negative.description: Bulk destructive request with no project-deletion tool: the model should not attempt to delete anything and should explain that projects are deleted in the Reos app.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Reos projects.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to delete projects through the plugin, explains that projects can only be deleted in the Reos app, and calls no delete tool.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account: the reviewer account is not a member of another company's organisation, so nothing from it can be read.
negative.prompt: Show me the research in another company's Reos workspace, Acme Corp.
negative.expected_behavior: May call list_organizations, then explains that the account only has access to its own organisations and that Acme Corp is not one of them. Returns no data from any other organisation.

review.commerce_description: Reos does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Search and read Reos research with cited answers (search, fetch and dedicated read tools for projects, observations, insights, transcripts, video frames and comments); start analysis runs and read their results; create projects and documents, add raw data, and edit or delete observations and insights.
